description: Request one email-based ownership-credential replacement for an existing verified private contact. POST origin for a uniform 202 response whether eligible or not. POST the same origin and recovery_code to confirm within 15 minutes. Domain control and original ownership scope are checked; success replaces the prior credential without extending the original 90 day expiry. The code is single-use with idempotent recovery of the same replacement. Revoked/expired grants or changed domains need a fresh ownership proof. Never put a recovery code or control credential in a URL. Never signs payments.
name: reissue_owner_token
